sources.title: README.md · TenStrip/Wan2.2_H3_Motion_Lora at main
sources.snippet: This is a lora for the video h3 model, using wan2.2 attn layers on the mid to late H3 blocks with peak mapping. Wan's blocks are reversed to align better. Wan is 16fps but again H3's design seperation doesn't make the much of an issue, timestep isn't adjusted at all.

sources.title: GitHub - Wan-Video/Wan2.2: Wan: Open and Advanced Large-Scale Video ...
sources.snippet: 👍 Efficient High-Definition Hybrid TI2V: Wan2.2 open-sources a 5B model built with our advanced Wan2.2-VAE that achieves a compression ratio of 16×16×4. This model supports both text-to-video and image-to-video generation at 720P resolution with 24fps and can also run on consumer-grade graphics cards like 4090.

sources.title: Wan 2.2 I2V 14B LoRA Training with AI Toolkit | Image-to-Video
sources.snippet: Train Wan 2.2 I2V 14B image-to-video LoRAs with the Ostris AI Toolkit. This guide explains dataset design for motion, style and character LoRAs, Wan's dual high/low-noise experts, multi-stage settings, recommended frame counts and resolutions, and how to run I2V LoRA training on 24GB local GPUs or RunComfy's H100/H200 cloud.
